main_text.l: cretur,qui commentitias religiones in ecclesiam inuehunt: tamen Papatus noua nobis religionum figmenta inuexit, adeò absurda & ridicula, ut in tanta calamitate gratiæ tamen Deo immortali agendæ sint, quòd tantam improbitatem non nisi in stolida ingenia passus est incidere. Figmeta religionū hæc fere sunt: primum innumerabiles monachorum copiæ (genera sacrilega) quorum hæc fere nomina sunt. Franciscani, quo nomine comprehenduntur Cordigeri Conuentuales, Obseruantini, Minores, Minimi, Galochiferi, Capuchini, Amadei, Clarini, Azurini, Cartusiani, Hieronymitani, Heremitæ, & postremò Fratres ignorantiæ: quos omnes ordines Papa refert ad Francisci Assisini regulam & professionem: quem in Deorum suorum numero collocauit. Secundum locum obtinent, quos idem Papa sub regula, vexillum & nomé Augustini retulit: Heremitæ conuentuales, Sampaulini, Hieronymiani secūdi generis, Lupiniani, Apostolini, Brigidiani, Redemptionales in Hispania, Fratres prædicatores, Dominicani, siue Iacobini: Præmonstratenses, Congregationis Perusinę, Battistelli Genuenses, Ambrosiani, Doucettani, Zampanenses, Lombardi, Dalmatici, Serui Hospitalarij S. Antonij. Tertium ordine obtinent Benedictini, & sub eorum regula Cluniacenses reformati, Bernardini, Humiliati, Celestini. Huc accedunt Carmelitæ, Basiliani, Maturini, Theatini, & quos omnium istius generis veteratorum vaferrimos, callidissimos & fraudulentissimos esse constat, IESVASTRI: qui non discipulos se, aut ministros, aut sectatores Iesu profitentur, sed voce blasphema & nefaria IESV DEI socios.

page.notes: Printed page 17 with running head FVLMEN. Signature b. j. at right foot. Spaced capitals in IESVASTRI and IESV DEI are as printed. Doubtful readings: the first word "cretur" is cut at the left edge and may be a fragment (credetur or similar), so it is left as a fragment; "Figmeta" is printed thus; "Perusinę" has a doubtful final letter; "Hieron ymita-ni" shows a stray space in the print, transcribed as Hieronymitani; "Afsifsini" is read with long s as Assisini. Long s rendered as plain s; u/v and i/j normalised. No catchword and no Greek or Hebrew on this page.
